metadata.name: UK Legal Data Agent Hackathon Challenge
metadata.description: Focused six-question evaluation set for the participant diagnose-change-retest exercise.

evaluation_queries.question: How many active clients do we have?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our current active customer count?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step1_cleaned_customers WHERE status = 'Active'

evaluation_queries.question: What is the total value of all matters?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our complete case portfolio worth?

evaluation_queries.question: How much revenue have we generated?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is the total amount invoiced?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_gbp) FROM step1_cleaned_transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Invoice'

evaluation_queries.question: How many invoices remain unpaid?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our unpaid invoice count?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step1_cleaned_transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Invoice' AND payment_status = 'Unpaid'

evaluation_queries.question: How many legal cases are currently open?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: How many open matters are on our books?
evaluation_queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step1_cleaned_cases WHERE case_status = 'Open'

evaluation_queries.question: How many customers do we have?
evaluation_queries.paraphrase: What is our total client count?
